proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4435 *gharapāla “house guardian” explicitly gives Hindi gharwālā “husband” and gharwālī “wife”, alongside Sindhi gharavāro. The full survey gharval- household terms fit that compound family; the modern suffix may have been renewed or transmitted regionally. Uncertain transfer between Indo-Aryan languages does not prevent this supported family link under the user’s preference.
